content.caption: Operation: Midnight Snack was a tactical masterpiece. Or so I thought, until the 'giant mountain of kibble' turned out to be a very empty bowl.
content.scene: 阿橘, an orange short-haired tabby with amber eyes and cream paws, sits upright on a polished wooden floor. He wears a look of profound betrayal, staring intensely at an empty ceramic bowl. A single, solitary piece of kibble sits just out of his reach, framed by soft morning sunlight streaming through a nearby window.
